Experimental benchmark viewer — uploads are not enabled. Public research images only. A percentage is an estimated probability only when explicitly labelled that way; other percentages are uncalibrated model scores. The estimate assumes images similar to the public calibration set and is not a patient-specific probability. All boxes are approximate research proposals, not validated localisations. Not for patient care.
